experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit code calculation in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay exits with 143 (128+15) instead of 130 (128+2) because the signal handler maps SIGINT to 15, but the shell convention for SIGINT is 128+2=130.
experiment.falsifier: If the probe passes with expectedExit=130 after the edit, the hypothesis is confirmed; if it still fails or throws an error, the hypothesis is falsified.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Preserves the contract that relay.js returns the child's actual exit status (130 for SIGINT) rather than a hardcoded signal-derived code.
